chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hafs ibn al-Bakhtari, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding a man who shaves his head in Mecca, he said: He should return the hair to Mina.
ai.seo_question: What should a pilgrim do if they shave their head in Mecca instead of Mina?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Isfahani's al-Istibsar clarifies a procedural nuance in Hajj rituals, emphasizing that the validity of halq is tied to the specific location of Mina rather than the act itself. It reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on adhering to the Prophet's prescribed sequence of rites, ensuring that the pilgrim fulfills the obligation in its designated place. This ruling underscores the importance of intention and location in completing the minor pilgrimage rites before proceeding to Mecca.
